newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura shares stable after watchdog proposal.
newsitem.headline: Nomura shares stable after watchdog proposal.

text.p: Shares of Nomura Securities Co Ltd were stable on Wednesday morning after the news on Tuesday that Japan's securities watchdog had recommended that the Ministry of Finance punish Nomura.

Brokers said the news has mostly been factored into the market and participants were awaiting the Finance Ministry's decision on what kind of penalties to impose on the scandal-hit brokerage. The penalties are expected to be announced later this month.
At 0027 GMT, the Nomura shares were unchanged at 1,500 yen. Its volume was 1.259 million shares.

The long-awaited recommendation by the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) will pave the way for the Finance Ministry to take action against Nomura, expected to include the suspension of some of the top brokerage's key businesses, within a month, industry sources said.
